violation_type.title: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments (26 TAC §744.1005(a)(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: The program director assigned a caregiver to a location without all required new hire training to be left alone with children. In addition, the caregiver was not provided a key to access the program's first aid kit and a list of the children in care.
